patch.summary:
Choose Adobe Firefly only if your buying job matches “Adobe generative image/video — Free credits; Firefly Standard from ~$9.99/mo; Pro ~$19.99;” rather than Synthesia's shape. Choose Synthesia only if your buying job matches “AI avatar video studio — Basic free (watermark, no MP4); Starter $18/mo annual ($29 monthl” rather than Adobe Firefly's shape. Workflow advantage: Adobe Firefly leans ai-image; Synthesia leans ai-video. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Adobe Firefly is Adobe generative image/video — Free credits; Firefly Standard from ~$9.99/mo; Pro ~$19.99; also bundled in Creative Cloud.; Synthesia is AI avatar video studio — Basic free (watermark, no MP4); Starter $18/mo annual ($29 monthly); Creator $64/mo annual ($89 monthly); Enterpris.
- Company-size focus: Adobe Firefly (solo, small-business, mid-market) vs Synthesia (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Adobe Firefly-leaning ai-image vs Synthesia-leaning ai-video.
- Researched limits: Adobe Firefly — Premium video/partner models consume credits even when standard images are unlimited on paid plans; Synthesia — Basic cannot publish — no MP4 download and a persistent logo.

Limitations — Adobe Firefly: Premium video/partner models consume credits even when standard images are unlimited on paid plans; Standalone pricing is easy to confuse with Creative Cloud Pro bundles; Synthesia: Basic cannot publish — no MP4 download and a persistent logo; Credits buy minutes of avatar video — not unlimited renders.
